info.title: API.SH: Depop
info.description: The Depop API from API.SH: public Depop data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
Brands whose name starts with a letter (`id`, `name`, `slug`), or one brand by slug with its description.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/depop-brands

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: One brand by slug instead, e.g. `nike`.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Depop's departments (men, women, kids, everything else) with their category groups and product types: the ids the search `groups` and `product_types` filters take.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/depop-categories

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One Depop item: description, brand, category, status, price with its breakdown (item price, original price, shipping, buyer fee, on sale), free shipping, sizes, condition, colours and every listed attribute, location, like count, all photos, shipping method and the seller (id, username, link, verification, picture), plus `extended` (the site's price and like record) and `raw`. `latest=true` with search parameters opens the first item of that search.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/depop-item

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: The item slug (`slug` from search) or its depop.com/products/... link.

parameters.name: latest
parameters.description: `true`: open the first item of a search with the same parameters (`q`, `country`, filters) instead of a slug.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Depop market: `us` (default, USD), `gb` (GBP), `au`, `ie`, `fr`, `de`, `it`, `nz`, `ca`. Sets the shop country and the price currency.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

example.description: Nike Just Do It purple t-shirt in a L #justdoit #swoosh #nike says nike hoops on the back

attributes.product_title: Nike Men's Purple and Pink T-shirt

get.description:
Items for sale on Depop for a keyword, with every filter of the site's search: brands (slugs or ids), sizes, condition, colours, price range, gender, kids, department group and product type, on-sale items, and sort by relevance or price. Each item: `id`, `slug`, `url`, `description`, `brand`, `category`, `status`, `sold`, `price`, `original_price`, `total_price`, `currency`, `on_sale`, `shipping_price`, `sizes`, `size_set_id`, `condition`, `colours`, `gender`, `group`, `product_type`, `location`, `country`, `like_count`, `image`, `images` and `raw`. `total` is the site's count. Pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/depop-search

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Depop market: `us` (default, USD), `gb` (GBP), `au`, `ie`, `fr`, `de`, `it`, `nz`, `ca`. Sets the shop country and the price currency.

parameters.name: brands
parameters.description: Brand slugs (from /depop/v1/brands, e.g. `nike`, `levi-s`) or brand ids, comma separated.

parameters.name: sizes
parameters.description: Size ids `<size set>.<size>` (from /depop/v1/sizes or an item's `size_set_id` and `raw.sizes[].id`), comma separated, e.g. `54.5`.

parameters.name: price_min
parameters.description: Lowest price in the market currency.

parameters.name: price_max
parameters.description: Highest price in the market currency.

parameters.name: is_kids
parameters.description: `true`: kids' items only; `false`: no kids' items.

parameters.name: seller_id
parameters.description: Search inside one shop (its numeric id, `id` from /depop/v1/shop).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A Depop shop: `id`, `username`, `url`, first and last name, bio, website, verified, picture, followers, following, review rating and count (as seller and as buyer), items sold, last seen, items for sale, and the shop's item counts per category (`category_counts`) and per brand id (`brand_counts`), plus `raw`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/depop-shop

parameters.name: username
parameters.description: Shop username or its depop.com/<username>/ link.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

example.bio: Depop’s official Support shop. Expect educational content to help you make the most of your shop. Tweet us for help @askdepop

Reviews a shop received as a seller (default) or as a buyer: date, rating (1-5), text, transaction id, the item (id and photo) and the reviewer (id, username, verified), plus `raw`. 20 a page; pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/depop-shop-reviews

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
